description: Use this when the user asks how healthy a data center market is: composite score (0-100) aggregating supply/demand balance, vacancy, absorption velocity, fiber depth, power availability, and pricing trend. Returns the index value, percentile rank across the 300+ market set, 7d/30d trend direction, and underlying component scores. Answers "is this market healthy", "how does Northern Virginia look overall right now". Try: get_intelligence_index market=northern-virginia. Returns ONE composite health number for a market; do NOT use for the full market metric set (use get_market_intel) or to rank multiple markets (use rank_markets). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.
name: get_intelligence_index
title: Market Intelligence Index
